# v0.28.1 — session continuity, replay matching and profile settings

The RELEASE-READINESS-V1 gauntlet ran at the `v0.28.1-rc3` tag; its final verdict and the release-manager decisions are disclosed below.
Several measured rows are not green (Phase C, Track S D2, D5-B, the reference-agent window and local #1501). This GA rests on release-manager decisions that depart from the written gate for those rows; each is named, with its evidence, under **Qualification**.
This tree is that tag plus this notes file.
Its receipts are attached to this release (see **Qualification**).

This patch follows v0.28.0. It fixes one replay-duplicate shape (middle-window
placeholder matching, #1437), turns missing after CLI `/new`, false corruption advice,
short-turn vector coverage after rollback, and routed profiles reading the launch
profile's settings on multiplexed gateways. Other replay duplicates remain (#1674, see
**Known follow-ups**).
Local semantic recall and background leaf preparation stay optional and OFF by default.
There is no default change or new dependency.

## Upgrade

- **Host floor:** Hermes 0.21.3 or newer remains required; 0.21.5 or newer is
  recommended ([#1080](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1080)).
  CLI `/new` needs the host's reset-time `bind_session_state` callback. The pinned
  floor and 0.21.5 hosts provide it; real-host CI now includes these reset tests
  ([#1306](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1306),
  [#1619](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1619)).
- **Store:** there is no SQL schema migration. Chunk gap-fill adds coverage-bound
  and scan metadata while retaining the old integer revision marker. Older readers
  ignore the new records. Do not describe this as no store change
  ([#1536](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1536),
  [#1548](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1548)).
- **Rollback:** target `v0.28.0`. Keep a SQLite-safe backup. Compare ordered raw
  messages and the summary DAG through upgrade, rollback and re-upgrade.
  Older writers cannot update the new coverage records. On re-upgrade, the patch
  revalidates short-turn coverage and resumes pending gap-fill. Raw rows and FTS
  stay available; derived vectors can lag. This also repairs stores stamped by
  v0.28.0 before a v0.27.0 rollback. The inherited low-side gap after a second
  downgrade remains open ([#1543](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1543)).
- **Scope exception:** the already merged derived-index repair is the promised
  #1536 follow-up. It is included despite the patch rule's narrower product scope.

## Changes since v0.28.0

### Data integrity and session continuity
- **[#1438](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1438)
  ([#1605](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1605)):** CLI `/new` from an
  initially ignored or stateless session binds the next unfiltered session.
  Later turns are stored instead of left on the filtered binding.
- **[#1437](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1437)
  ([#1604](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1604)):** middle-window replay
  accepts literal and proven aliased placeholders without copying a durable tool window.
- **[#1529](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1529)
  ([#1541](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1541)):** warm proof keeps the
  newest two results literal, preserving a fresh retry's call and placeholder result.
  The older-result sibling remains open in #1540.

### Recall and operator behavior
- **[#1578](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1578)
  ([#1596](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1596)):** the doctor checks
  integrity on a fresh connection. Healthy FTS indexes no longer produce false
  corruption and restore advice after summary writes. Real corruption still fails.
- **[#1601](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1601):** when an out-of-range
  `LCM_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD` already has its own doctor warning and the runtime threshold
  equals the configured value, the doctor no longer repeats the generic threshold warnings.
- **[#1536](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1536)
  ([#1548](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1548)):** revalidate chunk
  coverage after rollback. Resumable scans and status include missing short turns.
- **[#1603](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1603),
  [#1611](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1611)
  ([#1614](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1614)):** routed profiles read
  their own settings and provider keys on multiplexed gateways. Background jobs,
  including assertions, retain that profile. The containment root stays process-wide.

### Repeated compaction and slow summarisers
- **[#1162](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1162)
  ([#1599](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1599)):** empty leaf input
  distinguishes missing source rows from a contiguity cut. Retained-occurrence
  stops still name their blocking row. This is diagnostics, not wedge recovery.

## Bench and instruments (no runtime change)
- Real-host CI covers the CLI reset contract and filtered-session `/new`.
  Previous-GA differentials and rollback readers now pin v0.28.0. Reliability adds
  a supported host rung and default-window cells
  ([#1619](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1619), #1575, #1582, #1577, #1530).
- **[#1554](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1554)
  ([#1617](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/1617)):** written rules cover
  D2 inconclusive results, reference-agent windows, D4 scheduling and resume, and
  injected-crash duplicates. The D2 fallback needs a two-run D7 producer first (#1620).

## Known follow-ups
- **[#1674](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1674):** replay can store a
  second copy of already-stored tool results and plain replies when the host's replayed
  rows carry no timestamps. v0.28.0 does the same. In the reproduction, the model's assembled
  context was not affected; recall can show the row twice. A fix and a repair for existing
  duplicates are planned for v0.28.2.
- **[#1675](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1675):** P3. The host's background-review fork asks the context engine to detach from its session.
  LCM-X refuses (fail-closed, as in v0.28.0), and the host keeps compression off for
  that fork. The host logs a caught traceback, and the doctor can report a stale
  lifecycle reference for the fork's unused session.
- **[#1508](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1508):** on hosts without
  message UIDs, a crash before a reply can make rotation replay store the next turn twice.
  When the host merges an unanswered turn into the next, only the merged turn is stored, with
  the older timestamp. v0.28.0 does the same. This release removes the capture (#1634); fix in v0.29.0.
- **[#1623](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1623):** when the user stops a
  turn with `/stop`, its assistant and tool rows are stored only when the session's next
  turn runs. The host skips the post-turn hook for an interrupted turn. v0.28.0 behaves
  the same way.
- **[#1501](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1501):** after an upgrade from
  a store written by v0.27.0, a post-crash user row can be stored a second time. Over
  ACP, a post-recovery duplicate mirrors the host's own transcript. v0.28.0 behaves the
  same way.
- **[#1624](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1624):** chunk-coverage
  revalidation costs: a status re-scan until maintenance records coverage, eager chunking
  before cancellation, and a coverage marker that misses a backward cursor. All are P3,
  and none affects raw rows.
- **#1250:** cold post-turn ingest without conversation identity can block later
  publication. The preventive fix remains open in #1252; it leaves existing rows unchanged.
- **#1186, #1197:** built-in default-on local recall and self-scheduling catch-up
  remain outside this patch. The short-turn repair is partial coverage.
- **#1096, #1097, #1141, #1162:** diagnostics and retries do not recover every wedged
  store. Retained-occurrence reconstruction is follow-up work (#1598).
- **#1555:** publication conflicts and ineffective repeat compactions remain under
  investigation. The #1603 settings fix does not claim to solve every cause.
- **#1179, #1286, #1446, #1451, #1511:** cold retry scaffolds, stale proofs,
  occurrence-snapshot durability/remapping and same-position cold re-sends remain open.
- **#1440, #1449, #1509:** pending-tail atomicity, disputed UID proof and a predecessor
  outside the warm audit remain open. No unmerged MAY item is claimed fixed.
- **[#1540](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1540):** a retry with two
  or more later results can remain unstored until a cold restart. #1529 fixes only
  the newest-two cases.
- **[#1525](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1525):** rows appended below
  a previously shortened host-list length can be missed. The fix is deferred to
  v0.30.0; the same outcome exists on the previous GA.
- **#1232:** name-only tool-result replay still needs occurrence proof.
- **#1149, #1388, #1397, #1399:** extraction deadlines, timing attribution and encoder
  or scheduler exit races remain open. **#1084, #1112:** CI mitigations do not prove
  flake causes. **#1539:** host-sensitive test fixes remain test-only follow-ups.
- **#1111, #659, #1073, #1145:** pre-answer defaults, the verbatim carry packet and
  background-preparation defaults remain separate. Constraint continuity beyond the
  fresh tail still needs measurement (#659).
- **#1531, #1532, #1533:** background-preparation cost, rate guidance and route
  fingerprint follow-ups remain open.

- **[#1636](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1636):** with the identity anchor off, a host that omits or fails the compaction boundary callback may store an older salvaged tool result twice; this is not reached on supported host paths and is a non-blocking follow-up for v0.29.0 after GA.
